title: Aloha Coquí | Stylish Unit with Pool in Rincón
description: Please be sure to click “Show more” to read the full listing description, including important details and house rules, before booking. If you have any questions, feel free to contact us - we’re happy to help and look forward to hosting you!The spaceAloha Coquí is the perfect beachside getaway. This stylish 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom garden apartment in Rincón offers direct beach access, a kitchen, a living area with cable TV, a washer and dryer, and a small balcony. Both bedrooms feature a queen bed and AC. Maximum occupancy is 4 guests.The complex includes a pool and the rental comes with 1 parking spot. Rincón is where breathtaking sunsets meet vibrant beach life, offering an unforgettable blend of natural beauty and laid-back charm. Aloha Coquí is fully air-conditioned in all living areas and bedrooms.LIVING AREAAs you enter Aloha Coquí, you'll be welcomed by a cozy foyer furnished with an aqua-colored bench. Beyond the foyer, you'll find an open-concept space that combines the dining and living areas. The dining area features a modern wood and glass table with sleek chairs, while the living area offers a comfortable sofa and a flat-screen TV—perfect for unwinding after a day at the beach. The living room also opens onto a cozy balcony with two chairs, ideal for relaxing. The kitchen is more secluded and it will be to your right after passing the foyer. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSThere are two bedrooms at Aloha Coquí. The master bedroom has a queen bed, and the second bedroom also has a queen bed. Both bedrooms have closets, two nightstands, blackout window treatments, and air conditioning. The full bathroom with bathtub is located in the hallway right between the two bedrooms. PACK AND PLAY (SUBJECT TO AVAILABILITY): We can leave a complimentary Pack and Play at the property upon request. This should be requested upon booking or no later than 5 days before arrival. Pack and Plays are subject to availability.KITCHENThe kitchen at Aloha Coquí is thoughtfully tucked away from the main living areas, offering a private space for meal preparation. It is completely equipped for an extended stay with a fridge, freezer, microwave, stovetop, oven, coffee maker, and toaster. You'll also find the washer & dryer in this area. GETTING AROUND & PARKINGWe strongly recommend renting a car, as there are a multitude of activities within a 15-30-minute drive that you will not want to miss out on. Also, Uber is not readily available in the area, which is why it's important to have your own means of transportation.The villa includes one (1) assigned parking spot.LOCATIONThere are many things to do in Rincón, Puerto Rico. This part of the island is best known as "The town of beautiful sunsets." Staying at Rincón you will enjoy a laid-back atmosphere, delicious restaurants, and great surfing beaches. Here are some of our favorite things to do:Explore the large selection of local restaurants. Some of our favorites include The English Rose, La Cambija, Carta Buena, Kaplash, El Tamboo Beside the Point, The Beach House, and La Copa Llena. Check out a new restaurant called La Serina, a great Tiki bar and sushi bar located downtown. Relax at the Balneario de Rincon and enjoy some refreshing pool time at the communal pool. Enjoy a beautiful sunset dinner at La Copa Llena.Visit the local beaches like Steps, Maria's Beach, Sandy Beach, Domes Beach, and Corcega.Take a picture of the beautiful "El Faro Lighthouse" at Punta Higuero.Watch an afternoon of surfing at Marías Beach and stop for a drink at the Calypso Bar which is right by the beach.Take a paddle-board tour with the folks at Rincon Paddle Boards.Other things to noteSTARTER AMENITIESAt West Indies Vacation Rentals, we strive to provide top-notch amenities, ensuring our guests feel at home during their stay. All properties come with freshly laundered bed linens and towels. We provide 2 bath towels per guest and 1 beach/pool towel per guest.We provide a set of disposable essentials to help you get your vacation started comfortably. These include:- 1 set of hotel-size soap and shampoo (per bathroom)- 3 garbage bags- 1 roll of paper towels- 2 rolls of toilet paper (per bathroom)- 1 dish soap- 1 dish sponge- A small amount of laundry detergent Please note that we do not provide unlimited disposable amenities. It is the guest’s responsibility to review what is included in the property and stock any additional items needed for the duration of the stay.Most properties also include at least 2 beach chairs and an ice cooler. You may reach out to us 5 days before arrival for confirmation. CHECK-IN / CHECK-OUT TIMESCheck-in begins at 4:00 PM, and since this is a self-check-in unit, you can arrive anytime after that.If you’d like to check in earlier, please contact us the day before your arrival, and we’ll confirm availability. When possible, early check-in typically starts around 11:00 AM. Please note that early check-in is subject to availability and depends on our cleaning schedule.If you need a guaranteed early check-in, you will need to book from the night prior to ensure the property is ready upon your arrival.Check-out time is at 11:00 AM. For late check-out requests, please reach out the day before your departure, and we’ll be happy to check availability for you.INSTANT & LAST-MINUTE BOOKING POLICYInstant Booking is available if reserved at least 2 days before check-in.For same-day or next-day reservations, availability depends on our cleaning schedule. You’re welcome to send a booking request, but please note that this does not guarantee the unit is booked—all requests must be reviewed and approved by our team. Requests sent late at night may not be reviewed until the following day, and same-day bookings are usually not accepted after 6:00 PM.We appreciate your understanding!HOUSE RULESNO SMOKING: Smoking is not permitted anywhere on the property. A $500 smoking fee will be charged if this rule is violated.NO PETS: While we are pet lovers, pets are not permitted at the property at any time. A $300 fine will be charged if this rule is violated, and guests may be asked to leave the property.QUIET HOURS: Quiet hours are from 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM. Please be mindful of noise during these hours out of respect for nearby residents/neighbors.UTILITIES (WATER & ELECTRICITY): In the event of an interruption to water or electrical service, the host is not responsible for hotel, alternate lodging, or transportation expenses. If service is interrupted for more than 3 hours, guests may cancel the reservation and request a refund for unused nights only. Nights already used are non-refundable.MAXIMUM OCCUPANCY: The maximum occupancy is 4 adults/children at all times, including visitors. OCCUPANCY ENFORCEMENT: Occupancy limits are strictly enforced. Exceeding the maximum occupancy may result in immediate cancellation of the reservation or removal from the property without refund.TOWELS & LINENS: Towels and linens are provided for normal use only. Please do not use them for cleaning or allow them to be stained with food, grease, or other substances. Charges may apply for damaged or stained items. TOWEL HANGING: Please do not hang towels or any other items to dry in areas visible from outside the unit. A $100 community fine may apply if this rule is violated.SUBLETTING: Subletting or re-renting the property is not permitted.TRAVEL INSURANCE / HURRICANE SEASONWe strongly recommend that all guests purchase travel insurance, not only during the peak months of Hurricane Season (July to October) but also throughout the year to cover unexpected events such as travel delays, pandemics, or other unforeseen issues.Travel insurance is inexpensive and can reimburse travelers for most expenses associated with canceling travel outside of the cancellation window; however, coverage will depend on the policy purchased. Make sure to review and understand the options before purchase.DISCLAIMER: We are not associated with any travel insurance companies.INTERACTION WITH GUESTSWe want your stay at West Indies Vacation Rental to be smooth and enjoyable. You can message us anytime after booking with questions. Starting 5 days before arrival, your designated Property Manager will also be available to answer any additional questions you may have prior to arrival. You’ll get all the essential property information 48 hours before arrival, as well as the Property Manager’s direct contact, so you’ll have support when you need it - before, during, and after your stay.

title: Mi Casita: Private Tropical Retreat
description: Experience the soul of Puerto Rico at Mi Casita, a private tropical haven where the countryside breeze meets modern comfort. Nestled in a lush, peaceful setting, our cottage offers total privacy just 5 mins from Aguada’s town center. Enjoy the best of the West: relax in our shaded gazebo, drive 9 mins to the Aguada beach for sunsets, or reach world-famous Rincón in just 15 mins. It’s the perfect balance of rural serenity and coastal adventure. Your authentic island escape awaits!The spaceWelcome to Mi Casita!Experience the perfect blend of rural serenity and coastal adventure. Mi Casita is a beautifully designed, 400 sq. ft. Studio Cottage that offers a "Modern Farmhouse" escape in the heart of the west coast.Our cottage features soaring high ceilings and a bright, open-concept layout that stays naturally cool thanks to the constant tropical breeze. Every detail is curated for a cohesive "Country-Chic" vibe, featuring artisanal wood interiors and charming farmhouse decor.SMART LIVING & SLEEPINGTo maximize your space, we feature a high-quality Twin-size 2-in-1 trundle daybed.🏠 BY DAY: Keep the trundle tucked away for a spacious, airy living room.🌙 BY NIGHT: Easily convert the space into two comfortable sleeping spots.KITCHEN & DINING🍳 THE KITCHENETTE: A functional workspace with custom cabinetry, a stainless steel sink, an electric cooktop, a mini-fridge, and a coffee station.☕ DINING NOOK: An elegant wrought-iron bistro set for two—the perfect spot for your morning coffee with a view.OUTDOOR OASISStep outside to your own private sanctuary:🌿 FRONT PORCH: An expansive shaded area to enjoy the breeze.🛖 PRIVATE GAZEBO: A dedicated space for "al fresco" dining or relaxing.🌳 THE GROUNDS: Exclusive access to a lush green yard surrounded by bamboo and palms.UNBEATABLE LOCATIONEnjoy the peace of the countryside while staying close to everything:📍 5 MINS — Aguada Town Center (Restaurants & Shops)🌊 9 MINS — Aguada Beach (Balneario)🏄 15 MINS — World-famous Rincón beachesGUEST ACCESSYou will have the entire 400 sq. ft. cottage and the surrounding private grounds all to yourself. Parking is on-site and secure.—————————————————————BOOK YOUR WEST COAST RETREAT TODAY!—————————————————————

title: Ocean and Mountain Views, Large Private Pool
description: Enjoy this spectacular property, a large bedroom and 1 Bath situated in a quiet dead end road with beautiful views of the Ocean and Valley. Only a few minutes away from Sandy beaches and restaurants as well as 8 minutes to Rincon and less then that to grocery stores, a pharmacy and a bakery. Enjoy jumping in our spacious pool and dine outdoors on our large covered terrace.The spaceWe provide:- We provide the basic supplies like trash bags and toilet paper to get you started but after that please feel free to drive a minute down the road to Colmado Rodriguez, a small store, for your additional needs. -Modern AC unit- Comfortable memory foam mattresse- Fresh bath towels for each guest - Swimming pool with water fountain and beautiful illumination at night- A large dining table on our covered terrace - can also be moved inside if so desired) - TV (Connect to your Netflix or Hulu account to enjoy movies)- Internet- A fully equipped kitchen with gas stove and oven. - Microwave- Coffee maker- Quality blender for smoothies and mixed drinks- Bluetooth speakerWhat we do not provide at this time:- Beach towels, beach chairs, umbrellas etc- Cable Television- Entertainment subscriptions such as Netflix, Hulu, Apple TV etc. - Access to a washer and dryerIMPORTANT:Puerto Rico can occasionally experience power and water outages. They are beyond our control. We provide a backup generator that can run from 6 pm to 7 am and will need to be turned off during the day. We also provide backup water (cool only-not heated) - we have a 400 gallon cistern that gravity feeds the house. The pressure will be significantly lower but you will have water in the house. Please, only book if you are willing to accept the above stated for the rare power and water outages that we are experiencing. ———- absolutely no parties allowed. - if bodily fluids are found on any of the furniture or on the beds etc. then an extra $500-$1000 charge may be added for additional cleaning. - if you show up with more than the allowed guests then your reservation may be canceled immediately/on arrival

description: "We have used Airbnb several times over the past few years and we can honestly say this was the best experience we have ever had." - NancyExperience the allure of our captivating Airbnb, Rincon Sunrise Peaks, situated amidst the stunning mountains of Puerto Rico's western coast. Experience the fusion of contemporary luxury and the awe-inspiring beauty of nature in our expansive 2-bedroom, 1-bath retreat. Be captivated by the panoramic views and unique mountain goat and sheep experience!The space"We loved being on the goat farm, the kids loved hearing and seeing the goats come up close to the balcony." - RichiTreat yourself to an unforgettable experience where modern comfort meets the charm of the Puerto Rican countryside. Rincon Farmhouse-ish is more than just accommodation; it's an invitation to unwind, recharge, and create lasting memories in the lap of scenic luxury.Modern Farmhouse Living:Indulge in the convenience of a full kitchen adorned with modern appliances, perfect for culinary adventures. The expansive dining table, adorned with chic bar stools, sets the stage for memorable meals and engaging conversations. Your entertainment needs are met in a dedicated area, and the private balcony beckons with awe-inspiring views of the majestic mountains and mesmerizing sunsets—truly the epitome of relaxation and uniqueness.Bedroom Bliss:The first bedroom with two twin beds exudes charm and functionality, featuring a ceiling-to-floor mirrored closet that adds an extra touch of sophistication and table lamps with USB port access for phone charging. The second bedroom is a sanctuary of luxury, boasting a queen-size bed and a cozy sofa. A wall-to-wall/ceiling to floor mirrored closet enhances the sense of space and style. What sets it apart is its exclusive doorway leading to a washer/dryer area, where you can indulge in laundry with a view. Take in the sights of coconut trees, majestic mountains, and the delightful presence of friendly goats and lambs—a picturesque scene right from your own private retreat!Both rooms are equipped with AC for your comfort.Bathroom Oasis:Step into a bathroom oasis featuring a wall-to-wall stand-up shower, complemented by a ceiling fan to enhance your comfort. Deep hand sink, bath towels, luxurious robes and essential amenities add the perfect finishing touches to your bathing experience.Experience Tranquility:Rincon Farmhouse-ish is not just accommodation; it's an immersive experience where every detail is curated for your comfort and delight. Unwind on the balcony, savor the sunset, and let the charm of this unique farmhouse-inspired haven transport you to a world of tranquility.Guest accessRincon Farmhouse-Ish is a two-story property, each level serving as a distinct home. The upper level is the owner's residence, with a separate entry, ensuring their privacy. Guests enjoy exclusive access to the entire lower home, accessible through a private entrance, requiring just one flight of stairs for entry.Other things to noteWiFi & smart tv AC unit on all bedroomsPrivate Washer/Dryer Every room including bathroom, hallway and living room is equipped with powerful ceiling fansAmple parking space available in front of the airbnb or right across.

description: Our warm and welcoming home is an extension of the elements you will find in Rincón & in our sea-hugging neighborhood of Corcega. Private and secluded, yet near & walkable to conveniences & amenities. On a quiet road with few neighbors & forest across the street. Easy second-level living with privacy from the downstairs studio apartment, & may share several outdoor spaces under lush tropical foliage. Enjoy epic sunsets, swimming, & stargazing at the beautiful beach at the end of the block.The spaceCasa Esperanza is nicely secluded on a quiet dead-end street with plenty of parking on both sides of the street. When renting the whole house, you will have access to two separate and private levels. Upstairs has two bedrooms, one bathroom, large open and full kitchen/ dining/ living room and balcony. Ground-level has one big studio apartment with king bed, kitchenette and bathroom. Shared and mutual spaces of the outdoor kitchen, fully-screened hammock lanai, laundry room, outdoor shower and multiple outdoor seating areas. We pride ourselves on creating beautiful, relaxing, well-appointed, welcoming and livable spaces for you enjoy as your home away from home. We feel fortunate and blessed to have access to this slice of paradise, and want others to respect our home, neighbors, and community as if it were your own.All common areas and sleeping areas have ACGuest accessWhen you rent the whole house, you have access to everything except for one upstairs locked closet, storage sheds, and kayak.Other things to noteWe provide clean linens, towels, and toiletries for your stay and convenience of travel. We also have a queen air mattress available for you as well. This listing is for a single unit of our two-unit home. There may be times when you interact with others sharing the property, and we encourage guests to mutually enjoy the outdoor spaces. The home is a concrete fortress and you likely will never know someone is in the other unit while there. It is important to note that we live on an island and that we cannot control all of the elements. Occasionally, you may experience a brief interruption of water or electricity. At times, the water pressure form the city may briefly change, and is beyond our control, as you will find all across the island. Please know we will always do our best to prioritize your safety and comfort.Also, if you are visited by any of the cats that live on our block, please be sweet to them, as most are very gentle and friendly. Feeding them is a kind act, but please do not feed them on our property (there are bowls across the street where they are accustomed to being fed by kind humans). We are particularly fond of Miel (the mostly black/ tortoise spotted girl) and her sweet kitten crew that adopted her as their leader. PLEASE DO NOT LET ANY OF THE CATS INSIDE THE HOME. Thank you.
